name: Chalk
description: A dark, schedule-first template for strength gyms, CrossFit boxes and coached fitness studios — rubber-floor graphite walls, chalk-white condensed type and one plate-red accent, a numbered program list, the whole week on one timetable board with every class coded in its program's bumper-plate color, a chalk-white first-class band that walks nervous beginners through their first hour, memberships compared side by side, and a free-trial call to action.
